blurb: NK Designs & Gifts is a "Do It Yourself" Workshop in Merced where you can create custom wood signs and many other DiY projects for your home or as a gift. It's a place that allows you to make memories that could last a life time. By crafting these DiY projects with family and friends it's easy to get addicted.
